decisions.reason: After two years on the market, the aloe vera facial care line still appears to be a committed close-to-core extension with manageable carrying costs, so the firm is likely to keep harvesting information rather than withdraw it.

The hyaluronic acid serum fits the firm's established skincare capabilities and its continued market presence suggests acceptable prospects, even if it remains somewhat easier to prune than a more prominently supported line.

The cleansing milk is still inexpensive to keep as a close-to-core option, but its lighter emphasis and possible overlap with other facial cleansers make it one of the more disposable items if results stay only moderate.

Because the cleansing oil is the newest launch and still in the learning phase, management would usually keep the option open for another year, though its limited prominence means it could be dropped if early demand proves weak.
